description: This file defines the TimesheetPeriodFactory class within the OrangeHRM Time module. It provides methods to create instances of timesheet period classes, specifically for weekly timesheet periods.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating instances of timesheet period objects, such as WeeklyTimesheetPeriod.

methods.name: createTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a timesheet period class specified by class name.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Returns a new instance of WeeklyTimesheetPeriod. Currently a placeholder method.
